description: D054 exact candidate comparison batch with independent review C outcomes pinned by checksum. Three candidates need-fix (2,6–10 except 4), and the S009 color reading is explicitly held for a single-image tiebreak; artwork remains unapproved.
review_notice: Unapproved D054 reference comparison. Independent review C pass: S004 v010; prior independent passes retained: S001 v005, S003 v005, S005 v004. Independent review C needs-fix: S002 v006 (Garuda contract jewelry); S006 v005 (orange cowherd skin R−B 149–157); S007 v004 (uncontracted Krishna jewelry, orange gopa skin, fingerless merged arms); S008 v003 (forehead mark, heavy jewelry, Krishna whole-figure B−R 36); S009 v004 (uncontracted Krishna earring/bangles); S010 v004 (orange Bhattathiri and gopas, uncontracted Krishna jewelry). On S009, producer and independent reviewer differ on whether the measured gopa skin R−B 123–135 is too orange or natural warm reddish-brown; a single-image tiebreak is pending. S002 and S008 source-photo mismatches and other mappings remain as documented in the plan. No art approval.
visual_review_status: Independent exact-checksum review C is preserved under a distinct reviewer identity. S004 v010 passes despite a producer needs-fix toe-count observation; the reviewer described one clear toe tip and ambiguous lesser-toe strokes on the side-view foot, judging it normal. The remaining exact selected images requiring fixes are S002, S006, S007, S008, S009 and S010. S009 skin tone is reserved for a single-image tiebreak; Krishna jewelry is independently needs-fix. No art approval.

rows.scene: Saubhari sits in meditation beneath the clear surface of the Kalindi, with a small fish shoal nearby; Garuda appears overhead at the riverbank, seen by the sage. Keep the underwater and surface layers legible within one continuous landscape scene. No split collage.
rows.candidate_status: The independent reviewer passed the exact v005 checksum; measured Saubhari chest R−B 121, warm russet-brown in full frame. Prior producer review recorded needs-fix at R−B 119 and orange reading; Firstmate instructed keep this independently passed candidate.

rows.scene: At the river surface, Garuda takes one fish from the water as Saubhari watches from below or the bank and raises a restrained hand in a spoken curse. A few fish remain in the water; avoid graphic injury.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix: Garuda wears a jewelled diadem, earrings, upper-arm bands and wrist bangles not listed in his contract; all other assessed anatomy and scene elements passed.

rows.scene: Garuda drives the proud hooded Kaliya toward the dark waters of Kalindi. Show one continuous serpent body entering the river, with Garuda’s two wings clearly attached. A small ritual offering remains on the bank as context for the cause.
rows.candidate_status: The independent reviewer passed the exact v005 checksum; Garuda’s regalia is removed and contracted simple ochre cloth remains.

rows.scene: A poisoned stretch of Kalindi damages the riverbank: two clearly separate dried trees, a few birds falling toward the ground, and one youthful Krishna watching with compassion from the bank. Do not show Kaliya or a physical poison cloud, halo, or light rays.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review passes this exact v010. Tiebreak found one clear toe tip and 2–3 implied lesser-toe strokes on the side-view far foot; the reviewer judged it a normal side view, not a defect. Producer’s separate needs-fix count remains preserved.

rows.scene: On a very hot day, young Krishna has entered the Yamuna forest without Balarama. Thirsty cowherds and a modest herd drink from the poisoned river; Krishna is present but does not drink. Show a calm, non-graphic warning moment before collapse.
rows.candidate_status: The independent reviewer passed the exact v004 checksum; gopa shoulder R−B 126 was judged warm ochre-brown in the full image. Prior producer review recorded needs-fix based on additional sampled patches; Firstmate instructed keep this independently passed candidate.

rows.scene: Krishna comes close to the fallen cowherds and cows and compassionately restores them with his sidelong glance. Show several figures beginning to rise and breathe; the nectar-like mercy is conveyed through gesture, water, and expression only, with no rays or beams.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix: cowherd skin samples R−B 149–157 are visibly copper-orange; Krishna’s measured blue and costume pass.

rows.scene: Three distinct adult cowherds rise in wonder at the bliss throughout their bodies, recognize Krishna’s act, and embrace him with natural, connected limbs. Keep the embrace readable and the hands visible only where they can be clearly drawn.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix: Krishna wears uncontracted palace-like ornaments; cowherd skin measures R−B 139–162; at Krishna’s waist the central hand is fingerless and the right forearm merges into it.

rows.scene: A small distinct herd of newly revived cows gathers around Krishna, gazing at him with joyful, moist eyes and open gentle mouths. Krishna remains the single clear youthful figure; keep each animal’s legs and head distinct.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix: cream forehead stroke reads as a forbidden mark; heavy Krishna jewelry is uncontracted; whole-figure blue B−R 36 is below the plan threshold.

rows.scene: A few distinct cowherds show gooseflesh and overwhelming joy, then bow at Krishna’s feet with reverent prayer. Keep Krishna’s smooth forehead bare as contracted, and make every visible open hand anatomically clear with a thumb plus four fingers.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix for Krishna’s crescent earring and wrist bangles, which are absent from the shared contract. Independent skin reading: gopa R−B 123–135, natural warm reddish-brown; producer measured 128/135/129 and judged it too orange. Single-image tiebreak pending; scene and anatomy pass.

rows.scene: A quiet devotional closing scene: Bhattathiri kneels before youthful Krishna, praying for protection and release from illness; two recovered cowherds stand nearby as beneficiaries of the same mercy. Krishna’s compassion is conveyed by a gentle sidelong gaze and an open blessing hand. No halo beams; fingers clear.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review needs-fix: Bhattathiri skin R−B 164–171 and gopa skin R−B 145–151 read orange; Krishna wears an uncontracted earring, necklace and bangles.
